name: Sam
features_and_traits: You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation.
You can add your Cha. modifier bonus to the damage rolls of Eldritch Blast.
You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.
You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.
You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 ft. of yourself.
You have Advantage on Con. saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and has a range of 10+ feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by 600 ft.
While you’re in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.
You can cast Jump without expending a spell slot.

As a Bonus Action, you can conjure a pact weapon in your hand, or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch. You can’t bond with a magic weapon if someone else attuned to it or another Warlock is bonded with it. Until the bond ends, you’re proficient with it and can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Cha. instead of Str. or Dex.; and you can cause it to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapons ends if you use this feature’s Bonus Action again, if the weapon is more than 5 ft. away from you for more than 1 minute, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.
| Pact of the Blade: Conjure: 1 Bonus Action
| Pact of the Blade: Bond: 1 Bonus Action
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with that cantrip, you can push the creature up to 10 ft. straight away from you.
Once per Long Rest, you can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute, regaining up to 2 expended Pact Magic spell slots.
When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, you gain 23 Temp HP. You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 ft. of you to 0 HP.
When you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can add 1d10 to your roll. You can do this after seeing the roll but before any of the roll’s effects occur.
You can use this feature 3 times per Long Rest, but no more than once per roll.

You always have Contact Other Plane prepared. Once per Long Rest, you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell’s saving throw.
You can choose one damage type, other than Force, to have Resistance to. You can change this choice whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum, choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast this spell once per Long Rest before you cast it in this way again.
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum, choose one level 7 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast this spell once per Long Rest before you cast it in this way again.

Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Cha. saving throw, or the target disappears, takes 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn’t a Fiend, and it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn, where it reappears in the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space.
Once used, you can’t use this feature again until you finish a Long rest unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot to restore your use of it.
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum, choose one level 8 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast this spell once per Long Rest before you cast it in this way again.
Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum, choose one level 9 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast this spell once per Long Rest
ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1.

Improve Fate. When you or another creature within 60 ft. of you succeeds or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

You can cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self once each per long rest. INT is your spellcasting ability and you cast these spells at their lowest possible level.
before you cast it in this way again.
When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.
You gain a breath weapon and damage resistance with your chosen dragon type.
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy. You can use your Breath Weapon 6 times per Long Rest.
You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.
You have Darkvision with a range of 60 ft.
Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, you gain temporary flight for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated
condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table. Knowledge of a language means your character can communicate in it, read it, and write it.
Ability Score Increase.One ability score of your choice increased by 1.
Truesight. You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.
* Boon of the Night Spirit • PHB-2024 211
Ability Score Increase. One ability score increased by 1.

Merge with Shadows. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.
Shadowy Form. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.
Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, add +6 to the roll.
Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing
